en.title: Nameless Rust Sleeping in the Fir Forest
en.premise: While conducting a botanical survey in a remote mountain range, I stumble upon the ruins of a 'vanished village'—a place erased from all records—deep within a dense fir forest. There, I discover a rusted mass of iron, resembling a broken sword, deeply embedded in the roots. As I begin to uncover the truth of what transpired in that village, I find myself quietly witnessing the process of nature swallowing and purifying the remnants of humanity.

zh.title: 沉睡在冷杉林中的无名锈迹
zh.premise: 为了进行植物相调查，我进入了人迹罕至的深山。在茂密的冷杉林深处，我发现了被从记录中抹除的“消失之村”的遗迹。在那里，我发现了一块锈迹斑斑的铁块，宛如一把折断的剑，深深地嵌入了树根之中。由此，我开始追寻那个村庄究竟发生了什么。这是一个静静注视着自然吞噬并净化人类痕迹的过程的故事。
